purpose: Creative and delivery defaults for selecting a video structure from a user request and available footage.

notes: Compose specifically for vertical framing; do not rely on a final center crop.
Use 60 fps delivery only when motion or source frame rate justifies it.
Prefer the source frame rate unless a deliberate timing treatment requires conversion.
YouTube recommends progressive H.264, AAC-LC or Opus, 4:2:0 chroma, and BT.709 for SDR uploads.

platformContext.note: These are project creative targets, not a claim about the current platform upload maximum.

platformContext.verifiedPlatformFact: YouTube classifies eligible square or vertical uploads up to three minutes as Shorts.
TikTok's auction in-feed specification recommends 9:16 and also lists 16:9 and 1:1.
YouTube identifies 16:9 as its standard desktop aspect ratio.

types.name: Cinematic Travel Reel
types.summary: A compact sensory story about moving through a place, built from establishing views, details, motion, people, food, and a hero reveal.
shotRecipe: Open on the strongest unusual motion, view, or reveal rather than a generic establishing shot.
Use one wide shot to orient the viewer, then alternate medium and close details.
Include human movement or POV to connect locations.
Reserve the best landscape, beach, skyline, or destination shot for a musical phrase change.
End on a held image, departure, look-back, or natural sound release.
types.audioStrategy: Use music as the main spine but preserve short location-sound accents for waves, traffic, crowds, doors, food, and vehicle movement.
avoid: opening with a weak wide shot

types.name: Fast-paced Reel or Short
types.summary: A hook-first short optimized for immediate comprehension, rhythmic escalation, and one clear payoff.
shotRecipe: Communicate the subject in the first one to two seconds.
Use text or speech only when the visuals cannot establish the promise.
Group rapid shots into phrases instead of maintaining maximum speed throughout.
Place the most satisfying result at the strongest late musical event.
Optionally make the final motion or framing connect back to the opening for a clean loop.
types.audioStrategy: Use high-confidence beats and onsets for emphasis, supported by a small number of impact or whoosh effects.

types.name: Motovlog Reel
types.summary: A first-person journey emphasizing route, speed, machine detail, surroundings, and arrival without losing spatial clarity.
shotRecipe: Open with movement, a striking road shape, a close pass, or a destination preview.
Alternate POV with controls, mirrors, landmarks, roadside details, and rider reactions when available.
Keep enough continuous road footage to preserve direction and geography.
Use speed ramps around clean acceleration or passes, not around hazards or unreadable motion.
Finish with arrival, engine stop, dismount, or a destination reveal.
types.audioStrategy: Retain selected engine and road transients beneath music; accent shifts, starts, passes, and arrival while avoiding a continuous harsh wind bed.
avoid: cutting so fast that road direction is lost

types.name: Talking Head with B-roll
types.summary: A concise spoken argument or story in which B-roll proves, clarifies, or emotionally supports each statement.
shotRecipe: Choose the cleanest complete statement before optimizing pace.
Remove dead air and repetition while preserving natural breath and intention.
Cover jump cuts with B-roll that directly illustrates the current phrase.
Return to the speaker for emotional turns, important claims, and the conclusion.
Keep captions inside a conservative center-safe region.
types.audioStrategy: Dialogue is authoritative. Duck music under speech, preserve room tone across removals, and let B-roll ambience enter briefly when it adds meaning.

types.name: Food Reel
types.summary: A tactile sequence built around transformation, texture, sound, plating, and reaction.
shotRecipe: Open with the finished dish, a texture reveal, pour, cut, or flame.
Alternate overhead, medium hand action, and macro detail.
Match cuts on repeated hand or utensil motion.
Slow down steam, sauce, cheese pull, slicing, or final garnish when source frame rate supports it.
Include a human reaction or clean hero plate at the end.
types.audioStrategy: Layer crisp preparation sounds such as chopping, sizzling, pouring, and plating over a controlled music bed.
avoid: orange color cast on all foods
only close-ups with no place context
slow motion on ordinary static shots

types.name: Compact YouTube Vlog
types.summary: A three-to-five-minute authored journey combining direct address, observational scenes, B-roll, and clear chapter progression.
shotRecipe: Use a short cold open containing a promise or later highlight.
State the goal quickly, then move into observed action.
Alternate spoken context with sequences that can play visually and sonically.
Give each location or activity a beginning, middle, and end.
Conclude with a concise reflection rather than an extended sign-off.
types.audioStrategy: Use multiple restrained music cues rather than one continuous track; preserve scene ambience and prioritize dialogue.
avoid: thirty-second intro montage before the premise
repeating the same information in speech and visuals
using short-form pacing for five minutes

types.name: Product Demo
types.summary: A problem-solution presentation that proves a product benefit through clear operation and visible results.
types.audioStrategy: Keep explanation and operation sounds clear; music supports momentum without competing with proof.

types.name: Tutorial or How-to
types.summary: A stepwise explanation where continuity, labeling, and proof matter more than maximum pace.
types.audioStrategy: Instruction is authoritative; use music only as a quiet continuity bed and retain useful tool sounds.
avoid: cutting before a result is visible

types.name: Motion Graphics Explainer
types.summary: A designed explanation using typography, diagrams, icons, and animated emphasis around a concise voice track.
types.audioStrategy: Synchronize graphic entrances to speech emphasis or light onsets; never let music reduce voice clarity.

types.name: Lyric Video
types.summary: A music-led typography piece where lyric timing, hierarchy, and visual atmosphere carry the story.
types.audioStrategy: Music is authoritative; visual and text events follow phrase, downbeat, and lyric timing.

types.name: Gaming Highlight
types.summary: A setup-to-payoff sequence using gameplay clarity, reactions, captions, and selective replay or emphasis.
types.audioStrategy: Preserve game cues and reaction speech; use music and effects to support rather than conceal the payoff.

types.name: Podcast Clip
types.summary: A self-contained conversational insight presented with readable captions and restrained visual support.
types.audioStrategy: Conversation is authoritative. Repair level differences, preserve turn-taking, and use little or no music when it distracts.
avoid: cutting out context needed for the claim

types.name: Fitness Reel
types.summary: An energetic progression showing preparation, effort, form, intensity, and completion.
types.audioStrategy: Accentuate foot strikes, weights, breaths, and equipment impacts while retaining enough natural effort to feel authentic.
